Item 8.01. Other Events. 

On April 17, 2025, Judge Leonie M. Brinkema of U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia issued a mixed decision in the U.S. Department of Justice s ( DOJ ) case against Google LLC ("Google"), a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc., ruling that the DOJ failed to show that Google s advertiser tools or acquisitions of DoubleClick and AdMeld were anticompetitive, but that Google s publisher tools violated antitrust laws by excluding rivals. Google plans to appeal the adverse portion of this decision.
